fidelity.guide.title.welcome: Your data stays on this device
fidelity.guide.body.welcome: Track3 keeps balances, history and settings in a local database. API keys are stored on this device only. Nothing is sent to a Track3 server.
fidelity.guide.body.sources: Connect an exchange with a read-only API key, add a wallet by address, or link Interactive Brokers with a Flex Query. Add as many as you like.
fidelity.guide.body.history: History keeps one snapshot per refresh. Open any date, compare two of them, or see what moved between them.
fidelity.guide.body.deeper: Set target allocations and tolerances in Rebalance. Add rules in Goals & alerts for prices, allocation and profit.
fidelity.guide.body.backup: Export JSON any time or enable automatic backups every 24 hours or after a refresh. You can also sync between devices through an S3-compatible bucket you own, end-to-end encrypted.
